chunks: And whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Mihrān, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Barqī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Mihrān.

key_terms.السَّعْدَآبَادِيِّ: A nisbah identifying one of the narrators in the chain
key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: A nisbah identifying Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Barqī in the chain
key_terms.الْمُتَوَكِّلِ: Part of the narrator’s name in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s narration through a specific chain
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِهْر: The narrator to whom this transmission route is being clarified

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Mihrān in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Mihrān in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying the route of narration.
